text_block_list.text:
One holiday.
I was out shopping when...

text_block_list.name: Bourbon & Rice
text_block_list.text: Hachi-mi~, hachi-mi~, hachi-mi~♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Performance of 'The Hachimi Song' concluded.
All missions regarding
'Honey Drink' have been executed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it was delicious!
I can see why Teio and the others are so into it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Furthermore—after singing with Rice,
the sweetness of the beverage increased.
...I deduce that singing affected my brain.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Operation 'Friendly Date'
proceeding smoothly. Deploying to the next location.

'Friendly Date'...
Come to think of it, the two of them were in the library before—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Keeping up this momentum, our next mission...
Volume 9, Chapter 8 of 'Besties ☆ Best Friends Club.'
Let us carry out the 'Best Friends Date.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
My heart's pounding a little, but I'll do my best...!

...Most likely,
they're carrying out the plan we talked about back then.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
'Trendy cafe photogenic hype trip'
commencing. ...Or rather, commencing, whoop-whoop!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
O-Okey-doke!
Let's take a two-shot, then!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ayy!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah... Both of them closed their eyes!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, it appears to be a silly photograph,
yet mere visual confirmation causes the corners of my mouth to elevate.
...'Insta-worthy'... Most intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san, have you decided on
the matching sports towel we will purchase?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Rice-san,
are you curious about that bracelet?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wha!? Oh, i-it's nothing!
Um... It's so hard to choose matching towels, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe. I wonder if we can share a towel
over our heads like Kita-san and Satono-san?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Bourbon-san?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Simulation complete. Thank you for waiting.
Let us begin pointing at the towel as scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Aw~... the store's closing.
Picking the same one is hard, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. However...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Proposal for Rice-san:
Shall we make this our shared accomplishment for today?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Th-This is...
...Could it be that bracelet from earlier?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! The bracelet matches 
Bourbon-san's, doesn't it...
Rice has to give you something in return, too!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Then, how about having Rice-san present
the matching sports towels we buy?
...What do you think of that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah!
You're right, that way both of them will be happy!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
All right... I'll do my best to nail the point-and-call,
and report back to Bourbon's father~!

text_block_list.name: Bourbon & Rice
text_block_list.text: Aiming to be the friendliest pair... Ei, ei, oh!

Wherever I went today, I caught glimpses of the two of them,
and seeing them constantly work together
truly made them look like an 'inseparable pair'.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—...Decline in... consciousness level... confirmed.
Physical abnormality... detected...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wait! Th-this is bad!
We have to find somewhere to rest...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Rest has confirmed stable readings.
Deactivating Sleep Mode.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm sorry, Bourbon-san.
Rice ended up getting you into trouble after all...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negative. The cause of my reduced activity is
a decline in sleep quality over the past few days,
resulting in a bug in my stamina calculations.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In short—I was so excited for our 'friendly date'
that I couldn't sleep.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-san...
You were looking forward to it that much...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I request a re-execution of the mission.
I shall gather knowledge to prevent recurrence.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Then Rice will tell you a little spell
to help you sleep well, too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see,
first you place the sheep picture book by your pillow—

Wherever I went today, I caught glimpses of the two of them,
and seeing them brainstorm strategies together
truly made them look like an 'inseparable pair'.
